I submitted the pizza order, and httpbin echoed back the form data I sent:

- **Customer name:** Ada Lovelace
- **Telephone:** 555-0100
- **Email:** ada@example.com
- **Size:** large
- **Toppings:** bacon and cheese (Extra Cheese)
- **Delivery time:** 19:45
- **Delivery instructions:** Ring twice

Typing into the time field didn't work, so I set 19:45 with a script instead. The echo shows it was submitted correctly.

The result page (`https://httpbin.org/post`) is still open in the browser tab.

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); agent-browser --session $S open https://httpbin.org/forms/post; agent-browser --session $S snapshot -i

B="agent-browser --session task-aae26cc78b0f"; $B fill @e2 "Ada Lovelace"; $B fill @e3 "555-0100"; $B fill @e4 "ada@example.com"; $B check @e7; $B check @e8; $B check @e9; $B fill @e12 "Ring twice"; $B focus @e14; $B keyboard type "0745PM"; $B snapshot -i
